title: Cell Culture Supernatant Collection
protocol: Plate cells at a concentration of 1 million cells/mL on Day 1.
Switch to serum-free or EV-cleared media 24 hours after plating.
Collect supernatant after 24 hours for hESCs or after 48 hours for NRVMs and KMBCs.
Centrifuge the collected supernatant at 500 x g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.
Centrifuge the transferred supernatant at 2,000 x g for 10 minutes.
